ModMetaData.name: Aragorn – Armee der Toten (v0.38)
ModMetaData.author: Aragorn Mod Project
ModMetaData.description:
DEUTSCH — Aragorn – Armee der Toten
Rette Aragorn, schmiede Andúril neu und befreie 13 Geisterkrieger in einer zusammenhängenden Questreihe. Beschwöre eine Geisterarmee mit sechs Klassen, nutze den Königlichen Befehl, mächtige Blitze, Andúrils Rundumschlag und Aragorns EMP-Sturm. Gegnerstärke, Geisterrüstung und Fähigkeiten sind einstellbar.
ENGLISH — Aragorn – Army of the Dead
Rescue Aragorn, reforge Andúril, and release 13 spectral warriors in a connected quest campaign. Summon an army across six classes and wield the King's Command, devastating lightning strikes, Andúril's sweeping attack, and Aragorn's EMP Storm. Adjust quest difficulty, spirit armor, and abilities in the mod settings.
v0.38 | RimWorld 1.6 | Expanded six crypt maps with large multi-room structures, solidly supported indoor roofing and RimWorld FogGrid.Refog to conceal enclosed chambers until discovered. Sword crypt now 64x44 (approved 52x32 core and 3 sealed annex rooms); archer, axe, captain and royal trials now 71x55; bombardier ritual crypt remains 65x49 with newly roofed western/eastern chapels and inner sanctum. Archer and bombardier Profaned defenders spawn behind real cover and defend independent firing posts instead of wandering around an empty open hall. New optional Profaned darklight braziers, lanterns and steles decorate rooms. All 13 indestructible tombs, global enemy slider, past save progression, weapon graphics and previous v0.37.1 Harmony hotfix remain unchanged.
